Pork & Chive Dumplings

Time: time
Servings: servings
Source: Google class
Tags: tested, savory, snack, main-course, medium-effort, meat, milk-free

Ingredients

  • 250g Ground pork
  • 20g chives, finely chopped
  • 2 cloves Garlic, minced
  • 1⁄2 inch Ginger, minced
  • 1⁄4 Cabbage thinly sliced and diced
  • 1⁄4 tsp pepper
  • 1⁄2 tsp Salt
  • 1⁄2 - 3⁄4 tsp Baking soda
  • 2 tsp Sesame oil
  • 2 Tbsp Soy sauce
  • 2 Tbsp Water
  • 2-3 Tbsp Cornstarch
  • Sheets Gyoza wrappers

Instructions

  1. Mix pork, chives together and fold in the diced cabbage.
  2. Stir in the remaining ingredients and add baking soda. Loosen up the mixture with the water so it becomes nice and juicy.
  3. To form the dumplings, remove 1 wonton wrapper from the package, covering the others with a damp cloth. Brush the edges of the wrapper lightly with water. Place 1⁄2 rounded teaspoon of the mixture in the center of the wrapper. Shape as desired. Set on a sheet pan and cover with a damp cloth. Repeat procedure until all of the filling is gone.
  4. Place a medium nonstick skillet on stove top, medium heat. Add oil to bottom of pan. Place dumplings in pan, let the bottom get crispy. Pour about 2 tablespoons water into pan. Place cover on top of the pan. Let cook until water evaporates. Plate and serve.
